about_the_game: The Automate It Original Soundtrack is a collection of 28 tracks from the immersive in-game soundtrack, composed by Pablo García Lozano. Each piece has been carefully crafted to capture the dynamic and engaging atmosphere of Automate It, blending subtle harmonies with energetic themes to accompany the player's experience.
